plugins.name: medviet-ui-ux
plugins.description: MedViet UI/UX: build screens for MedViet apps fast and consistently. Ships the turbo-web design system (EMR teal palette, Roboto, status colours) and its @medviet/ui primitives as a starter, shared blocks the apps keep re-writing (status badge, time input, row actions, confirm dialog…), add-ons (signature, Excel import/export, A4 print, virtual list), and Aura's checks: hooks block hand-built UI, raw colours and duplicates, and aura verify reviews the rendered page. Internal to MedViet.
